{{Quote|Gungans no dyin' witout a fight. Wesa warriors.|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
'''Militiagungs''' were soldier [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] that had joined and been trained in [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]]. Militiagungs were loyal to the Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] and were willing to die serving their leader. Militiagungs' weapons often were usually [[Booma/Legends|booma]]-launching [[Atlatl/Legends|atlatls]] and a [[Gungan personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shield]].

Militiagungs had existed for an unknown number of year before [[3000 BBY]], when the [[War of the Gungan tribes]] took place. Many of the individual tribes were training militiagungs to fight the other tribes. Eventually [[Gallo/Legends|Boss Gallo]] rose up and defeated [[Rogoe/Legends|Boss Rogoe]], the warlord responsible for the war, using an army built up of militiagungs and other Gungan military forces. The Gungan Grand Army was formed afterward.

The Gungan Grand Army did not see very much warfare until [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Many militiagungs were called to arms for the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]], where the army engaged the Trade Federation and would have been defeated if it weren't for the intervention of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who destroyed the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]], disabling all of the battle droids on Naboo.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a large group of militiagungs journeyed off-world to [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to assist the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] in a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|battle]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] led by [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]]. In the first confrontation many Gungans were killed and the survivors were placed in [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camps. Eventually [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] of Mon Calamari led a revolt against Tamson, with the militiagungs' help, and defeated the Separatist forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

At some point during the Clone Wars the Gungan race nearly invaded [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] after Boss [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]] was placed under hypnosis by Separatist spy [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]]. The trickery was realized by Anakin Skywalker, now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], who along with [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] tricked the Separatist forces planning Theed's invasion into believing the Gungans were still allied with them long enough to capture the army's leader, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], which cost the lives of several militiagungs including [[General/Legends|General]] [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]].

Militiagungs were still used by Gungans at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
===War of the Gungan tribes===
[[File:SanctureBattle.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A group of militiagungs commanded by Boss Gallo battle bursas on the ruins of Otoh Sancture]]
Around [[3000 BBY]] the various Gungan tribes were at [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] with each other, during which militiagungs were very commonly used in the battles. One Boss who did not use militiagungs was Boss Gallo, who refused to take part in the fighting until his city, [[Otoh Sancture]], was [[Destruction of Otoh Sancture|destroyed]] by half-wild [[Bursa/Legends|Bursas]]. Gallo would later find out the bursas were sent by Boss Rogoe, the warlord manipulating the war, who feared that Gallo would be too powerful a force should he enter the war. Gallo then built an army of militiagungs with the help of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marsune (Gungan)|Marsune]], a reformed rogue, and proceeded to [[Battle of the Forest Cities|resolve]] the issues causing the Gungan tribes to go to war with each other. Eventually Gallo had a large enough army to [[Raid on Spearhead|invade]] [[Spearhead/Legends|Spearhead]], Rogoe's base, and defeat the tyrant. The battle ended the war and resulted in the formation of the Gungan Grand Army and the building of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] which was built on Spearhead's ruins.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Invasion of Naboo===
{{Quote|Wipe them out. All of them.|Darth Sidious|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
====Swamp Battles====
{{Quote|My troops are in position to begin searching the swamps for these rumored underwater villages. They will not stay hidden for long.|OOM-9|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
[[File:Naboo_Swamp_Battle.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Trade Federation forces attacking the Gungan swamps.]]
Three [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]] later, Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="NEC" /> The Gungans were initially safe from the Federation as they were unaware of their existence, until a captured [[marine]] from the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Harte Secur]] informed the Trade Federation of myths of a mysterious water-dwelling civilization. [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] was sent to [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|attack]] the city of [[Rellias]] with the assistance of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the manipulator of the invasion. The droid army reached the city with ease and killed all of the Gungans there, including the militiagungs defending the city, except for [[Ganne|Boss Ganne]], whom Maul used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on to lead them to the [[Rellias Straits]], the entrance to Otoh Gunga.<ref name="SW:GB" /> The droids defeated the Militiagungs scattered on the path to the channel with ease. Otoh Gunga's attack resulted in a decision by the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Rep Council]] to evacuate the city.<ref name="GT!">''[[Gungan Trouble!]]''</ref>

====Battle of the Sacred Place====
{{Quote|When in trouble, Gungans go to sacred place.|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
[[File:Gungans.png|thumb|left|250px|Militiagungs at the Gungan Sacred Place.]]
The Gungans who escaped from Otoh Gunga immediately left for the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]]. A large number of militiagungs had arrived at the Sacred Place before Boss Nass had. A [[Scout/Legends|scout]] reported that a Trade Federation camp was nearby. In order to ensure the Gungans safety, Nass ordered that a large group of militiagungs to [[Battle of the Sacred Place|attack]] the camp. The battle was brief and the Gungans only suffered light casualties.<ref name="SW:GB" />

The Gungans continued hiding until [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] along with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], arrived to negotiate with the Gungans. The group defeated a large number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] before meeting the militiagungs guarding the Sacred Place. Several militiagungs challenged the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in combat, but were easily defeated by the Knights. The [[Gungan Security Chief]] then challenged the Jedi, but was also defeated. The Chief then let the Jedi through to meet with Boss Nass.<ref name="JPB">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'']]</ref>

====Gathering Forces====
[[File:Second_Battle_of_Spinnaker.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Militiagungs held hostage by Battle droids at Camp Fourteen.]]
Queen Amidala was able to persuade the Gungans to forge an alliance to remove the Trade Federation's presence from Naboo. Nass began to make preparations for the upcoming campaign with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]]. They realized a large amount of militiagungs and Naboo soldiers had been captured by the Trade Federation and been placed in [[Camp Fourteen]], a prison camp near the ruined city of [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]]. The Gungan army attacked the camp and [[Liberation of Spinnaker|liberated]] the prisoners, then proceeded to free Spinnaker from Federation control.<ref name="SW:GB" />

The next target of the Gungans was [[Camp Six]], a Trade Federation prison camp for [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaas]], which they planned to skin and sell. The militiagungs used fambaas to carry [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] and other heavy equipment, so the Gungans [[Liberation of Harte Secur|attacked]] Camp Six to free the beasts. The militiagungs also fought in the ruins of [[Harte Secur]], another city destroyed by the Trade Federation.<ref name="SW:GB" />

====Battle of Grassy Plains====
{{Quote|Ouch Time.|[[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]]|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
[[File:DisIsNutsen-TPM.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Militiagungs fighting at the Battle of Grassy Plains]]
The militiagungs were then called into action as part of a diversion to allow the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|retake]] Naboo from the Trade Federation. The Gungan Grand Army drew the [[Trade Federation Droid Army]] into [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|open battle]] on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]].<ref name="SWE1" /> The army started the battle with their fambaa shield generators, which prevented the battle droids from successfully attacking the Gungans for a short time, but the droid forces eventually got past the shields and began to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the militiagungs.<ref name="SW:BF">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> The militiagungs continued to fight the battle droids, but began losing the battle and suffered even more casualties when the shield generators were taken out, allowing the heavy machinery of the Federation to fire upon the Gungans. General Ceel eventually had to order a retreat into the swamps. However the Trade Federation droids began rounding up the militiagungs who hadn't escaped in time, including Jar-Jar Binks, Roos Tarpals and General Ceel. The fighting ceased and the Gungans believed they had failed until the young [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|destroyed]] the Federation's [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]], deactivating all of the droids and allowing the militiagungs to claim victory.<ref name="SWE1" />

===Clone Wars===
====Battle of Mon Cala====
{{Quote|Gungans! The tide has turned in our favor.|Kit Fisto, after the militiagungs arrived|<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref>}}
[[File:Epguide402.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An army of militiagungs at the battle of Mon Cala.]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">The [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] takes place after the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], which ''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the aquatic world of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] was attacked by the Separatists, led by the [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]] Riff Tamson and allied with [[Nossor Ri/Legends|Nossor Ri]], the leader of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]. Rugor Nass's successor, Boss [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]], committed a large group of militiagungs to act as reinforcements during the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|battle]]. The reinforcements raised the morale of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] soldiers and turned the tide of the battle briefly. However, Tamson used the Confederacy's [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|trident ships]] to create whirlpools to confuse the Republic soldiers. The Separatists seized the opportunity and killed and captured many Gungans. Many of these captives were kept in [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camps until the arrest of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]]. The prince's execution nearly took place, but Nossor Ri betrayed Separatists and intervened, saving the Prince. All of the Gungan and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] prisoners were set free and fought in the final part of the battle, which saw Tamson killed by Lee-Char and Mon Calamari freed from the Separatist grip.<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>

====Skirmish on Naboo====
{{Quote|How does it feel to die?''"<br />"''Not die...sacrifice!|General Grievous and Roos Tarpals|<ref name="Shadow Warrior guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/shadow-warrior-episode-guide|text="Shadow Warrior" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>}}
[[File:GrievousCaptured-SW.png|thumb|left|250px|Militiagungs guard a captured General Grievous.]]
Later, there was unrest on Naboo. [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]], a Gungan minister, secretly allied himself with the Confederacy and manipulated Lyonie, the Boss of the Gungan capital, Otoh Gunga, into preparing for war against the Naboo people. Boss Lyonie had a hypnotic necklace planted on him by Loo. The Separatists were planning an invasion of Naboo and were going to use the deceived Gungans into fighting with them. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Jar Jar Binks, concerned by Lyonie's rallying of the militiagungs, invited Anakin Skywalker and Amidala, then a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], to resolve the problem. Skywalker immediately noticed Lyonie was acting strangely and discovered the necklace controlling him. The necklace was crushed and Lyonie returned to his senses. He went to confront Rish Loo, whom upon being discovered stabbed Lyonie and fled, with Skywalker in pursuit. With Boss Lyonie injured, Binks impersonated him and spoke to the gathered militiagungs, talking them down from war. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] then [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|landed]] a Confederacy invasion force, and held a private meeting with Jar Jar (who he thought was Lyonie) to find out why the invasion was cancelled. Amidala contacted General Tarpals during this time and suggested deactivating the droid army. Grievous then worked out that Binks was not Lyonie and emerged from the meeting, enraged at discovering his army was deactivated. The militiagungs ordered him to surrender, but Grievous simply attacked the militiagungs with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Several militiagungs were killed before Tarpals attacked Grievous with an electropole. Grievous managed to stab the experienced militiagung, who in his last moments stabbed Grievous with his spear, giving the militiagungs a chance to capture Grievous. Grievous was held in captivity until [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] revealed he had captured Skywalker and was willing to trade for Grievous. The trade took place, and Skywalker was returned to the Republic.<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

===Later history===
Militiagungs were still used by Gungans during and after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWE6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Organization==
[[File:GunganTech-SWE.png|thumb|right|150px|Equipment used by militiagungs.]]
{{Quote|Wesa ready to do our-sa part.|Boss Nass|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
Prior to the formation of the Gungan Grand Army, militiagungs served the tribe they had been raised and trained in. When the tribes were united by Boss Gallo, the Grand army was formed, which required every [[City/Legends|city]] to hold annual drills so that the Grand Army could be assembled within thirty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of being summoned.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were trained to understand the Grand Army's system of horn, drum, and whistle signals, and took orders from professional [[Commander/Legends|commanders]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> There were several variations of the militiagung: the Trooper Recruit, Trooper, Heavy Trooper, and Repeater Troopers.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Weaponry==
{{Quote|Gotta energy balls, fly outta slings and splat electricity and goo. Bombad stuff.|Jar Jar Binks to Padmé Amidala on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]|<ref name="SWE1 novel" />}}
During the time of the Invasion of Naboo, a standard militiagung was armed with an atlatl, a [[Cesta/Legends|cesta]] and a personal energy shield. Atlatls were used to catapault energy balls, called boomas at the enemy. Personal energy shields were used to deflect blaster fire from hitting the militiagung.<ref name="SWE1" /> Some militiagungs also used electropoles.<ref name="JPB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Militiagungs first appeared in [[1999]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins. They were re-imagined in LEGO form for the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'', which was also included in its [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]]. Also released in 2005 was the video game ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', which allowed players to fight either for or against the Gungan Grand Army in "Hunt Mode."
